name: Active subscription becomes cancelled
reason: The original task directly requires this state transition. The repository context identifies status as the subscription state field.

name: Cancellation removes premium access
reason: The original task explicitly requires removal of premium access. The context identifies premium_access as the corresponding boolean field, but supplies no separate feature-access enforcement interface.

name: Repeated cancellation remains safe and consistent
reason: The original task explicitly requires safe repeated cancellation and a consistent cancelled state without premium access. The context says each HTTP request creates fresh state, so separate requests alone would not establish repeated cancellation of the same subscription.

action.explanation: Each documented HTTP request creates fresh subscription state, so it cannot establish repeated cancellation of the same subscription. The supported schema cannot directly invoke the Python callable or execute a multi-step sequence, and the context supplies no existing test command covering this behavior.
